Lemma
[Integral bound for positive circular averages] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0122 1. ch29:29.32\group Backward Pressure Limit

If the backward Euclidean conformal factor is finite at the origin, then for every $r_0>0$ and $t\le -1$, the integral of the positive part of the circular average of $\log \overline u$ over $B(0,r_0)$ is bounded by a constant depending only on $r_0$.
